outcome: duration of the second stage of labor
cohort: The study included 200 women who gave birth at Soroka University Medical Center, Beer-Sheva, Israel.
finding: Pelvic floor dysfunction (PFD) symptoms during pregnancy, specifically symptoms of CRAD, were found to be correlated with the duration of the second stage of labor.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy (for PFD symptoms) and at the time of birth (for SSL duration)
